title: Minimum μ for block
description: Essential: Correctly states the condition μ = tanθ for the block to stop.

title: Sphere final speed
description: Essential: Correctly gives the rolling speed u = (v sinθ)/(1+β).

title: Minimum μ for sphere
description: Essential: Correctly gives the condition μ = (β tanθ)/(1+β) for rolling without slipping.

title: Apply impulse-momentum
description: Important: Uses linear impulse-momentum correctly for the collision along the ramp.

title: Apply angular impulse
description: Important: Relates frictional impulse to angular momentum change for the sphere.

title: Rolling condition
description: Important: Applies the rolling without slipping condition u = ωR.

title: Friction direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for friction impulse relative to velocity change.

title: Confuses impulse types
description: Pitfall: Fails to distinguish between normal and tangential impulses or their maximum values.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies that final expressions for μ are dimensionless and speed has correct units.
